notes.title: Avernum 4: Greed and Glory Out For Windows/Mac on October 22nd!
notes.content: [p]Started in 1994, the cult classic Avernum series is one of the great video game sagas. On October 22, Spiderweb Software returns to this unique underworld nation with Avernum 4: Greed and Glory! Coming for Windows and Mac. [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3882020/Avernum_4_Greed_and_Glory/"]Take a look here![/url][/p][p][/p][p]In this new, epic fantasy role-playing adventure, you explore and save (or betray?) an enormous underworld nation. Battle through huge dungeons, fight unique and cunning foes, collect, create, and bless hundreds of different artifacts, and enjoy a really cool story. [/p][p align="start"][/p][p]Avernum is a nation deep underground, full of huge caves, treacherous labyrinths, and fairylands of alien fungi. Once a prison, it has won its freedom and is now reaching for wealth and glory. However, old enemies from the deepest caves envy Avernum's growing power. You will have to fight to save this new, fragile land (or be well paid to betray it).[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]You can see an Avernum 4 trailer, screenshots, and plenty of information on our web site or on our Steam page. If you are interested, please [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3882020/Avernum_4_Greed_and_Glory/"]wishlist the game on Steam[/url]. It helps a lot! [/p]

notes.title: Avernum 4: Greed and Glory Kickstarter. Help make Spiderweb's next new RPG!
notes.content:
We have [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/spiderwebsoftware/avernum-4-greed-and-glory]launched the Kickstarter[/url] for our next game, and we're thrilled to finally return to the world of Avernum! [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/spiderwebsoftware/avernum-4-greed-and-glory]Avernum 4: Greed and Glory[/url] will be an epic, indie, turn-based fantasy role-playing adventure for Windows, Mac, and iPad. It continues the saga of Avernum, a nation in caverns far under the world, full of misfits, adventures, treasures to be found, and monsters to hunt (and that hunt you).

It will be a remaster of the indie RPG cult-classic Avernum 4, which came out way back in 2005. The original is a massive RPG, full of skilled warriors and wizards using a multitude of weapons, spells, and artifacts to conquer an enormous world. It is old and doesn't run well anymore. We will completely rework everything to make a great, modern game.

The Kickstarter will run until October 16th and comes with a huge variety of stretch goals and backer rewards. You can get all sort of merch, including stickers, hand-drawn original art, and the original, signed, annotated designs from our first game (back in 1994). We humbly ask for your support as we take this mostly-forgotten game from our past and rebuild it as something really cool.

notes.title: Geneforge 2 - Infestation, New Spiderweb RPG, Coming March 27!
notes.content:
Spiderweb Software's next epic adventure is coming out on March 27, 2024! Geneforge 2 – Infestation is a truly open-ended fantasy adventure in a unique world of alien fantasy. You are one of the Shapers, wizards with the awesome power to create life. Want a tool, a trap, an army? You summon it into existence. You create mighty beasts, and they totally obey you. Usually.

But your people have grown lazy and complacent, and a threat has appeared. Your creations are no longer content to serve you. You are lost in a wild, savage mountain range. A rebellion is growing there, and it offers you awesome power if you join. Will you use your powers to destroy the rebels or aid them? Bring peace or lead them to war? The choices are all yours!

To see a trailer or wishlist Geneforge 2, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2480560/Geneforge_2__Infestation/]go here[/url]!

Geneforge 2 – Infestation offers unmatched freedom in how you play. Fight alone with blades, missiles, or magic, or create your own army of custom-made mutant monsters. Alternately, use trickery, diplomacy, and stealth to win the game without ever attacking a foe. There's no 'bad guy'. Choose between a host of rival factions or just destroy everything.

Geneforge 2 is an epic fantasy adventure with almost ninety zones to explore, 50+ hours of gameplay, and huge replayability. Choose from dozens of spells, weapon skills, abilities, and creations to make to reach a vast array of different endings. The rebellion has begun. Awesome wealth and power is yours for the taking. What will you do?

Geneforge 2 – Infestation is a total remaster of our 2003 cult-classic Geneforge 2. It contains new areas, quests, characters, and dialogue, a redone interface and systems, and a complete reworking of every single thing to bring it into the modern era of gaming.

notes.title: Geneforge 2 - Infestation Kickstarter Launched!
notes.content:
We have [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/spiderwebsoftware/geneforge-2-infestation]launched a Kickstarter[/url] for our next title, a full remaster of Geneforge 2, released wayyyy back in 2003. Geneforge 2 - Infestation will be the second chapter in the reborn Geneforge Saga. We want to go over it and redo everything, adding new characters, quests, monsters to create, and training paths to scorch (or save) the mountains of Drypeak.

We’re really excited about the remasters. The first one, Geneforge 1 - Mutagen, is our best-selling game in a long time, and its follow-up will have a lot of fun new stuff to keep the series fresh for newcomers and old fans alike. The Kickstarter will run for a month, and it has a mix of old and new stretch goals and rewards. Backers can still add content to the game (an experiment which has been a huge success), and, for the first time, you can now get physical Spiderweb merch.

We can only still make our odd little games with the support of our fans, and we're hugely grateful. Come check out the new Kickstarter here ...

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/spiderwebsoftware/geneforge-2-infestation

- Jeff Vogel
Spiderweb Software

notes.title: Queen's Wish 2: The Tormentor Announced, New RPG From Spiderweb Software!
notes.content:
Queen's Wish 2: The Tormentor is the second chapter in the indie, epic Queen’s Wish Trilogy. You are royalty of the Empire of Haven. A routine diplomatic mission in a brutal, barbarian land has turned into bloody chaos. Fight to calm your subjects, or hunt for a way to set them free.

Explore a vast nation full of cities, forts, and dungeons. Fight clever, carefully designed turn-based battles. Deal with misbehaving vassals with bribery, diplomacy, or violence. Build new forts and customize them, choosing among upgrades that give your adventurers powerful bonuses.

Spiderweb Software is back! Our next, all-new game, Queen's Wish 2: The Tormentor, is coming to Windows and Macintosh at the end of Summer, 2022. 

Queen's Wish 2: The Tormentor will be taking part in Steam Next Fest, June 13-20. You can try out the demo, and heckle us during our developer livestreams.

Drop by the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1947750/Queens_Wish_2_The_Tormentor/]game page[/url] and wishlist it if you want to be informed when it comes out!

notes.title: Geneforge v1.0.2 - Minor Update
notes.content:
We've released a v1.0.2 patch for Geneforge 1 - Mutagen. It fixes a handful of bugs and typos.

Geneforge 1 - Mutagen has been a surprising success for us, and its sales were far beyond expectations. Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: v1.0.1 Update (Mar. 4, 2021)
notes.content:
The first update, to fix a bunch of stuff:

- A host of typo fixes and minor tweaks.
- A number of exploits have been fixed. Sorry!
- Endurance is now cheaper and gives you more health at higher levels.
- Dante’s Guile now helps with operating more sorts of machinery.
- Some early Leadership checks are easier.
- More Leadership checks give experience.
- Glaahk stings now do magical damage.
- Changing sound volume in Settings has clearer results.
- Errors in some endings have been corrected.
- Battle Betas you create are now a little stronger.
- Background sounds are slightly louder.

Steam trading cards should now be dropping.

notes.title: Geneforge 1 - Mutagen Livestream and Q&A!
notes.content:
Geneforge 1 - Mutagen is a unique, truly open-ended fantasy role-playing adventure in a strange, new world. Use battle or cunning to change the world, served by your own army of custom-made mutant monsters. Over 80 zones to explore and 50+ hours of gameplay. Multitudes of skills, abilities, factions, treasures, and servants to create.

Geneforge 1 - Mutagen is coming for Windows and Macintosh at the end of February, 2021. Progress you make in the demo will carry over to the full game, so you won't need to start over!

This livestream is done by the developer, a grumpy indie developer veteran who has been making his odd, low-budget, fun adventures for 26 years. Enjoy learning about Geneforge and the indie games business from a fun old crank.
